name: stop-review
description: When a turn ends, checks the final answer's format (a `Checked:` list after a change, no work parked under a heading the report has no list for, no question outside `Decision needed:`), asks the advisorModel to review a turn that used tools or asks the user something (a question or `Decision needed:`) against ~/AGENTS.md and the skill procedures appended after it, and sends the turn back once with every finding (again after the wake from a pause on a subagent or workflow; a paused answer that asks gets the review alone); an answer another Stop hook sends back, such as /goal, waits for the answer that ends the turn.
